title: UDP Receive
text: Receive data over UDP network from a remote device, 2 outputs; {Use host-target connection} uses Ethernet connection between development and target, {Local IP address} sets the destination IP address for receiving data Use host-target, {Local port} sets the destination UDP port to receive data, {Receive width} sets the width of Data output, {Receive from any source} sets the causes receiver to accept data from any IP, {From IP address} sets the source from which to receive, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the sample time of block, {Enable Simulink messages} sets the data as messages and {Maximum messages per timestep} sets the limits messages. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Use host-target connection
params.values: Use Ethernet connection between development and target computers ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Local IP address
params.values: Destination IP address for receiving data Use host-target connection (default)

params.name: Local port
params.values: Destination UDP port to receive data 1–65535

params.name: Receive from any source
params.values: Causes receiver to accept data from any IP address on (default) | off

params.name: From IP address
params.values: Source from which to receive data x.x.x.x
